page: OVHcloud rtx5000-28 is a dedicated GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. Compute is driven by an Intel Xeon W-3235 processor operating at a base clock of 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system provides 4 dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading, mapped directly to 4 vCPUs, alongside 16 MB of L3 cache. Memory capacity totals 28 GB of RAM, equating to 7 GB per core. For accelerated computing, the instance features a dedicated NVIDIA Turing-architecture Quadro RTX 5000 GPU equipped with 16 GB of GDDR6 VRAM. Storage is bundled with a local 400 GB SSD, while networking capabilities provide a baseline throughput of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results highlight strong specialization in machine learning inference tasks, particularly for compact models. In LLM evaluations, the RTX 5000 GPU reaches top-tier classification, delivering 10,592 tokens per second for prompt processing and 386 tokens per second for generation on small 135M parameter models. On medium 7B models, prompt processing maintains 1,854 tokens per second with generation reaching 67.4 tokens per second. In contrast, CPU-centric metrics demonstrate average to modest throughput. The system recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 1,437 and a multi-core score of 4,430, alongside an average PassMark CPU score of 7,500.98. Memory write bandwidth for large blocks sits in the lower quartile at 19.59 GB/s, while cached read bandwidth performs within standard parameters at 353.33 GB/s.

This server type presents a balanced price-to-performance profile for workloads requiring hardware-accelerated processing without the higher cost of large-scale enterprise accelerators. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing baselines, though the 4-core limit and modest multi-threaded throughput make it less suited for massive parallel CPU-bound compute or high-volume compression jobs. Primary suitable workloads include small-to-medium LLM inference, computer vision inference, graphic rendering, audio/video transcoding, and medium-scale scientific computing pipelines.
description: OVHcloud rtx5000-28 is a GPU-focused cloud instance featuring an Intel Xeon W-3235 processor clocked at 3.3 GHz across 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture. It includes 28 GB of system memory, a 400 GB local SSD, and 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Compute acceleration is provided by a dedicated NVIDIA Quadro RTX 5000 GPU with 16 GB of GDDR6 VRAM. While CPU benchmarks demonstrate middle-tier single-core and lower-tier multi-core execution speeds, the dedicated GPU delivers top-tier performance for localized deep learning tasks. In benchmark tests, the instance processed 7B parameter language models at over 1,800 prompt tokens per second and 67 text generation tokens per second. The server offers a cost-effective platform for workloads such as small-to-medium model inference, computer vision, media transcoding, and 3D rendering pipelines.
